title: 3D image hover
description: An image tilts in depth when you point at it.
how: CSS perspective gives the square image depth. Its transform changes from 70 degrees to 20 degrees over 0.8 seconds. A rotated lower face adds thickness.
interaction: Hover over the image. To toggle the lifted state, tap it or focus its button and press Enter or Space.
accessibility: Reduced motion keeps the image at a fixed 20-degree angle. The image button has a visible focus outline.

title: Animated underline
description: A curved underline draws beneath text as the section enters view.
how: An IntersectionObserver activates the heading at 75% visibility. CSS changes the SVG stroke dash offset from 390 to 60 over one second.
interaction: Scroll down to draw the underline. Scroll away, then return to replay it.
accessibility: Reduced motion shows the complete underline without a transition.

title: Apple text reveal
description: Two text blocks slide into view on opposite sides of a horizontal rule.
how: Overflow clips two text blocks. The top block rises for one second, with a pause halfway through. The bottom block starts after 1.4 seconds and slides down for 0.5 seconds.
interaction: Open the page to play the sequence. Select Restart demo to replay it.
accessibility: Reduced motion shows both text blocks in their final positions. The top phrase has a complete accessible label.

title: Canvas drawing
description: A canvas records a freehand stroke as you drag across it.
how: Pointer coordinates define rounded blue strokes in the canvas 2D context. Pointer capture keeps a stroke active outside the canvas. Stored points restore the drawing after resize, and the backing resolution follows the display pixel ratio.
interaction: Press and drag with a mouse, pen, or finger. Select Clear drawing or Restart demo to erase the strokes.
accessibility: Drawing requires a pointer. Text instructions and a named drawing area describe the interaction. Pause autoplay does not stop drawing.

title: Word fade
description: Words become visible in sequence as their blur clears.
how: Each word fades from zero opacity and 4px blur over 0.8 seconds. Words start 0.1 seconds apart through inline animation delays.
interaction: Open the page to play the sequence. Select Restart demo to replay it.
accessibility: Reduced motion shows every word without blur. A complete heading label provides the phrase to assistive technology.

title: Pointer gradient button
description: A radial highlight follows the pointer inside a button.
how: A DOM ref updates the position of a nested span without a React render for each pointer move. A second span draws the 200px radial gradient and scales it into view over 0.2 seconds.
interaction: Move the pointer over the button. Use Tab to see a centered highlight and focus outline.
accessibility: Reduced motion keeps the highlight centered and removes its transition. Pointer tracking remains active when autoplay is paused.

title: Animated gradient border
description: A colored border rotates around a panel while its background changes opacity.
how: CSS registers an angle and an opacity property. Keyframes rotate the four-color conic gradient over four seconds and alternate the background opacity over three seconds. The gradient paints a real border.
interaction: Open the page to start the repeating effect. Use Pause autoplay to stop it at its current point.
accessibility: Reduced motion shows a fixed gradient border and an opaque background.

title: Overlapping images
description: Three overlapping images grow and tilt as their section enters view.
how: An IntersectionObserver activates the image group at 75% visibility. CSS transforms scale the cards to 1.2 and adjust their angles. The cards start 0.1 seconds apart, with a 0.4-second transition.
interaction: Scroll down to expand the image stack. Scroll away, then return to replay it.
accessibility: Reduced motion keeps the cards in a fixed overlapping arrangement. A section label describes the decorative images.

title: Image rotation
description: An image grows and rotates inside a clipped frame.
how: The frame clips its image. A 0.3-second transform scales the image to 1.3 and rotates it by five degrees.
interaction: Hover over the image. To toggle the rotated state, tap it or focus its button and press Enter or Space.
accessibility: Reduced motion keeps the image still. The button has a visible focus outline and the image has alternative text.

title: Letter fade
description: Letters move into place and become visible in sequence.
how: Each letter moves from a translated, tilted position and fades into view over one second. Inline animation delays stagger characters by six milliseconds. Word wrappers keep normal word boundaries.
interaction: Open the page to play the sequence. Select Restart demo to replay it.
accessibility: Reduced motion shows every letter in its final position. A separate visually hidden copy exposes the complete phrase to assistive technology.

title: Text wave
description: Letters rise in sequence and return to the baseline.
how: CSS keyframes raise each letter by 20px and return it to the baseline in a two-second cycle. Inline animation delays offset successive letters by 0.2 seconds.
interaction: Open the page to start the repeating effect. Use Pause autoplay to stop it at its current point.
accessibility: Reduced motion leaves the letters on the baseline. A separate visually hidden copy exposes the complete text to assistive technology.

title: Triple image hover
description: Three stacked images fan out at different angles.
how: CSS stacks three framed images and rotates them to 15, 7, and -5 degrees. Their entrance times are 0.5, 0.1, and 0.2 seconds. Each returns over 0.2 seconds.
interaction: Hover over the image stack. To toggle the fan, tap it or focus its button and press Enter or Space.
accessibility: Reduced motion keeps the images still. The named button has a visible focus outline; its duplicate decorative images have empty alternatives.

title: Typewriter
description: A line appears one character at a time beside a blinking caret.
how: A three-second stepped animation expands the text width to 27 monospace characters. It reaches full width at 75% of the cycle, then resets. A separate one-second animation blinks the caret. Width animation preserves the original centered typing effect.
interaction: Open the page to start typing. Pause autoplay stops both the text sequence and the caret. Restart demo starts a new cycle.
accessibility: Reduced motion shows the complete line and a steady caret. A separate visually hidden copy exposes the complete phrase to assistive technology.

title: Gradient underline
description: A gradient underline follows text across one or more lines.
how: CSS paints a gradient from the bundled original palette beneath inline text. On interaction, its height grows from 0.2em to 88% over 0.25 seconds. Cloned background decoration keeps the effect on wrapped lines.
interaction: Hover over the underlined words or focus them with Tab. Tap, Enter, or Space toggles the highlight. Resize the window to inspect wrapped text.
accessibility: Keyboard focus shows the highlight without motion. Reduced motion removes the transition. The text remains available without a network request.
